ReelMark Terms of Use

Last updated: October 14, 2026

These terms are an agreement between you and ReelRanks LLC, a California limited liability company doing business as ReelMark ("ReelMark", "we", "us"). By creating an account or using the ReelMark app you agree to them and to our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not use ReelMark.

1. What ReelMark is

ReelMark provides California ocean sport fishing regulation summaries, Marine Protected Area maps, weather, tide and ocean conditions, a catch log, a community feed, and an AI assistant (Salty and Fish ID) to help recreational anglers fish legally. ReelMark is an information tool, not a substitute for the law.

2. Regulations change — you are responsible for compliance

Fishing regulations change during the season. We work to keep ReelMark accurate against the California Department of Fish and Wildlife (CDFW) regulations, but we cannot guarantee that every entry is current or complete, and some species have no entry at all. You are responsible for complying with all applicable laws. Always verify current rules at wildlife.ca.gov/Fishing/Ocean or by calling CDFW at (831) 649-2801 before you keep a fish. ReelMark is not responsible for citations, fines or other consequences of relying on information in the app.

3. The AI assistant

Salty and Fish ID are powered by Claude, an artificial-intelligence model made by Anthropic. They can be wrong: a fish may be misidentified, and an answer may be incomplete or out of date. Treat them as a starting point, confirm the species and the rules yourself before you keep a fish, and never rely on them for safety decisions. The AI features are optional and can be turned off in Settings. By using them you agree that the photos and messages you submit are sent to Anthropic as described in our Privacy Policy.

4. Your account

  • You must be at least 13 years old to use ReelMark.
  • Keep your sign-in secure. You are responsible for activity under your account.
  • Give us accurate information and keep it up to date.
  • You may delete your account at any time from Settings → Delete Account.

5. Community rules — no tolerance for abuse

The community feed is for sharing catches with other anglers. We have no tolerance for objectionable content or abusive users. You agree not to post or send anything that:

  • harasses, threatens, bullies or demeans another person;
  • is hateful or discriminatory on the basis of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, disability or similar characteristics;
  • is sexually explicit, graphically violent, or promotes illegal activity, including poaching or fishing in violation of regulations;
  • is spam or advertising, or impersonates another person;
  • shares someone else's personal information without their consent;
  • infringes anyone's copyright or other rights.

To keep the feed safe: a word filter rejects abusive language before it is posted; every user can report a post or comment and block another user; reported content is reviewed within 24 hours and removed if it violates these terms; and we remove users who post objectionable content, immediately and without notice where warranted. Blocking a user hides their content from you and yours from them.

By posting to the community feed you give ReelMark a non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to store, display and distribute that content within the app to other users for as long as it stays posted. You confirm that you have the right to post it. Deleting a post or your account ends this licence, except for copies other users may already have viewed or shared outside the app.

You agree not to use ReelMark for anything unlawful; access or attempt to access other users' data or our systems without permission; scrape, copy or redistribute the regulation database, maps or other ReelMark content; reverse-engineer the app; or interfere with the service.
